2026_04_NYJ_CHI.headline: The Jets take their late-game fight to Chicago against a Bears team built to run
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.paragraph1: The Jets head to Chicago after rallying from a two-touchdown deficit before falling 31-24 in Detroit, a performance Aaron Glenn praised for its resilience but not its finish. Chicago presents a different stress point with a run game that has shown it can control games and create favorable down-and-distance. New York needs Geno Smith to stay efficient without exposing the offense to drive-killing pressure. The Bears can dictate tempo if their rushing attack keeps the Jets from unleashing pressure in obvious passing situations.
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.model_rationale: Chicago’s rushing identity can control tempo, while New York needs efficient quarterback play and better finishing to keep the Bears from dictating down-and-distance.
